name: kettlebell angled press
description: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell in one hand and hinge slightly to bring it near your knees.
Extend your hips to clean the bell into the rack position at your shoulder.
Brace your trunk and press the bell upward and slightly outward in a diagonal path.
Lock out without leaning back, lower to the rack, and switch arms after the set.
